selection: Select variant and confirmation by mean development out-of-fold spellF1, equal match/regime weighting, macroF1 tie-break. Dead evidence for each development fold is refitted with the frozen selected dead parameters on the other three development fixtures only. Never use the all-four-match dead model for development selection.
note: No new Viterbi decoder or dead-mask smoothing. Owners use prior and future confirmed geometric anchors, movement and missingness. All H/A/D decisions inside published periods; low-confidence/no-anchor cases remain explicit diagnostics rather than X. No competition data or labels.
